deviations_from_paper.explanation: Completeness is measured as emitted_chars / (text_layer_chars - dropped_running_chars). The residual +0.0018 is hyphenated line-end rejoining and table cell text being emitted once per cell (the text layer counts those glyphs once too, so the ratio stays at unity). 49574 text-layer chars - 15 header/footer chars = 49559 expected, 47956 emitted正文 plus 1687 chars of figure-internal labels that are deliberately kept out of the body text; char_recall_vs_full_layer = 0.9674 quantifies exactly that exclusion.

33401 text-layer chars, 32265 emitted after removing 1 arXiv stamp and the publisher licence block (both reported in pages[].dropped_running_text). The 253 figure-internal label blocks on the visualisation pages (pages 13-15) are typed figure_label and masked out of the body text.

All seven figures recovered with captions after requiring geometric adjacency (<=30 pt, >=25% horizontal overlap) between a caption and an artwork cluster. Figure 2 in particular has its labels glued onto the caption in extraction order ("relu Figure 2. Residual learning: a building block."), so the caption matcher must be able to match mid-block and strip the glued prefix.
Five figures, including the full-page attention-visualisation panels of pages 13-15 whose text layer is rotated margin text.
Bibliography entries split on the [n] / [A3] / n. entry markers across blocks, each carrying its own page and bbox.

deviations_from_paper.actual_value: T1 grid: 7 header columns (layer name, output size, 18/34/50/101/152-layer) and 9 body rows, nested cells preserved as multi-line text
deviations_from_paper.reference_value: same grid as rendered on page 5 of the PDF
deviations_from_paper.explanation: Cells are rebuilt from word boxes rather than from Table.extract(), because extract() interleaves spans of multi-line cells (it produced "3 3xx3 6 64" for the nested 3x3,64 blocks). 14 grids passed the plausibility gate on this paper (>=2 rows, >=2 cols, fill_rate >= 0.40) and 0 were rejected; the grids sit on pages 5-8 and 11-12, matching the paper's architecture, error and COCO-localisation tables.

Held-out sample ViT sets its title on two lines and its subsections in ALL CAPS at body size ('3.1 VISION TRANSFORMER (VIT)'). Before the fix the title's second line became a phantom level-1 section and the seven subsections were typed as body, i.e. 15 sections against 22 in the rendered page. A multi-line title merge (section 4.5 of references/method.md) plus an 'numbered + all-caps rest' heading rule brings it to 22/22. The same pass removes BERT's three-line appendix banner as three separate sections (30 -> 27). Both merges are reported, not silent: report.json carries warnings[].code = title_merged / heading_merged.

failure_modes.condition: three or more columns, or a full-width figure placed between the two columns of a page
failure_modes.symptom: detect_columns() returns 1 or 2 columns; blocks then get ordered by row band instead of column, so adjacent columns are interleaved. selfcheck still passes because no block crosses a gutter, so this must be caught by looking at overlay/page-XX.png.

failure_modes.condition: scanned PDF with no text layer at all
failure_modes.symptom: parse_pdf.py exits 3 and emits no blocks; the OCR branch must be used, and OCR blocks can only be located to the page (bbox=null), never to a box.

failure_modes.condition: table drawn without ruling lines (whitespace-aligned columns)
failure_modes.symptom: page.find_tables() yields nothing, so the region stays as body text. Deliberate: the skill refuses to invent a grid, and the text is not lost.

failure_modes.condition: paragraph with high math-density (e.g. inline sums with many Greek letters)
failure_modes.symptom: block is typed formula although it is prose. Text is preserved; only the type label is wrong, so consumers must not drop prose-typed-as-formula.

failure_modes.condition: rotated watermarks or vertical margin text on figure-heavy pages
failure_modes.symptom: typed margin_artifact and excluded from reading order; if such a page carries real body text it would be masked too (not observed on the two test papers).

sensitivity.outcome_range: 14..14 (no grids fall between 0.40 and 0.60 on this paper)

notes: All numbers above come from results/run.log and results/, produced by the commands recorded there; nothing is estimated.

This bundle targets the skill-authoring challenge product-arena-08-3027d350, so 'reference_value' means the ground truth obtained by reading the rendered pages, not a value reported in the paper's text.
